retrieval_evaluation.scope: CPU BM25 retrieval over complete public passages, not vector embedding search or inference/task success

real_agent_plan.selection: SHA256(seed:public_case_id) ascending, before observing RAG answers

plan.fault: one Agent coordinator exits after child Batch ACK, before Agent state commit
